title: État civil : le Mali engagé à moderniser et renforcer l'accès à l'identité juridique
why_not: Reports the minister's intention, at the 10 August 2026 Journée africaine de l'état civil, to pursue progressive digitisation; states no dated event of rollout or reversal, and the same ceremony is already held in the Malijet article of 2026-08-10.
